currentMilestone: v2.0 release candidate live; production UI and semantic search validated, offline browser gate pending
completedChanges: Replaced inherited code editor screen with Kryptic create/unlock, responsive vault shell, notes, journal, snippets, search, favorites, and trash UI.
Added IndexedDB vault configuration and encrypted item records using a random AES-GCM master key wrapped with a PBKDF2-derived key.
Updated page title, description, and manifest branding.
Debounced item autosave with serialized writes, flush on blur/lock/visibility change, and failure status; item identity checked after decryption.
Added Settings password change with current-password verification and atomic vault-key rewrap; fixed flushPending empty-queue result.
Replaced inherited README with Kryptic scope, security limitations, and roadmap.
Added encrypted per-entry tags, tag display, and tag terms in ordinary search.
Added 10-minute inactivity lock with pending-save flush and retry on save failure.
Added encrypted JSON backup, password and per-entry integrity validation, atomic empty-vault restore, and Settings/welcome UI.
Added per-entry plaintext Markdown, JSON, and PDF export with warning and safe filenames.
Added production app-shell service worker, install icons/manifest, Cloudflare security headers, and wait-for-commit IndexedDB writes.
Created editable Figma desktop vault, mobile vault, and create/unlock screens with 12 design variables, 3 reusable components, 69 editable text layers, and 17 instances.
Added up to five encrypted inline attachments per entry (2 MB each), included naturally in vault backups.
Added manual version snapshots (last 20) and restore with an automatic undo snapshot, encrypted in each item.
Added advanced search filters for tag, type, favorite, and date; added Ctrl+K command palette.
Added Chrome/Edge desktop local semantic search with browser worker and cached MiniLM model; mobile retains ordinary search.
Upgraded jsPDF to 4.2.1 after dependency audit and documented current feature scope.
Labeled package Kryptic 2.0.0-rc.1 and classified build/test dependencies as development-only; patched fflate to 0.8.3.
Added app integration coverage for advanced filters, Ctrl+K, revision restore, and stale semantic results; fixed stale semantic request handling.
Packaged ONNX WASM loader and binary on the Pages origin so desktop semantic search works under restrictive CSP.
Created Cloudflare Pages project and deployed verified release candidate to https://kryptic-5kk.pages.dev.
Reduced service-worker installation to seven core shell files; large semantic runtime assets now cache after first use.
Added a CI build wrapper that accepts only the known upstream Transformers import.meta warning and fails on other compilation warnings.
Published final 2.0.0-rc.1 production archive to Cloudflare Pages on 2026-10-01.
